brand_panel_width_px.note: Width of the mint brand panel. No panel width is supplied by the design foundation.

logo_height_px.note: Wordmark display height used by every placement on the Storybook Brand Assets page (width stays auto).

logo_clear_space_px.note: No clear-space rule is supplied. One logo height on every side is a neutral placeholder, not an official Atomity value.

title_font_size_px.note: atomity.css sizes headings for screens, not a 1200px social image. Weight 700 and -0.02em tracking follow the Storybook heading spec.

title_line_height_px.note: Whole pixels so line counts are exact.

title_max_lines.note: Longer titles fail validation with TITLE_OVERFLOW instead of shrinking or being cut.

body_font_size_px.note: Set in --font-body (Gowun Batang), the serif Storybook reserves for editorial copy.

body_line_height_px.note: About 1.55x, close to the 1.6 of .text-subtitle in atomity.css.

source_note_font_size_px.note: Set in Google Sans Flex: Storybook says running copy should never be set in Code.

source_note_line_height_px.note: Whole pixels so line counts are exact.

source_note_max_lines.note: Longer source notes fail validation with SOURCE_NOTE_OVERFLOW.

label_font_size_px.note: Storybook label scale: 13px, 700, caps, 0.1em, in Google Sans Code.
